title: terrain.support_beam_placed
description: M14E support-beam placement event. Emitted when the player uses the `support_beam_placer` tool: writes id=8 (support_beam) material at the target, debits 2 iron + 1 wood from the actor inventory, and locks the integrity field ±8 px around the target to integrity 500.

actor_id.description: Actor id of the player who placed the beam.

chunk_id.description: Chunk coordinate the placement landed in.

cost.description: Inventory delta the placement applied. Per spec: `2 iron + 1 wood`.

footprint_half_px.description: Half-extent (pixels) of the beam footprint written to the terrain. Default 8 → 16-pixel beam.
